LESSON: NUMBER RECOGNITION

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: NUMBERS 2.1 Rote counting By the end of the sub-strand, the • Guide learners to 
Topic 2.2: Number recognition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Number recognition. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which number is shown recognition should be able to: numbers on number flash on the flashcard?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use Number recognition to solve everyday problems

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Number recognition.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Number recognition using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. A few learners to identify chart that look alike? numbers on flash cards or charts
2. Learners sing songs related to numbers 1- 9
3. Learners model numbers 1- 9
4. In pairs or small groups learners to play number recognition games (fishing game)
5. Self efficacy as they sing and dance number songs,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which number is shown recognition should be able to: numbers on number flash on the flashcard?
2. Which number have you 10 lessons numeracy skills and symbolic • Guide learners to identify and modelled?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Number recognition is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
